svg.title: Plain and annealed Langevin
svg.desc: Left: the mixture 0.8 N(−4, 1) + 0.2 N(4, 1) and its versions smoothed by Gaussian noise of size σ = 1, 3 and 10, which merge the two modes. Right: histograms of 5000 samples from plain Langevin started uniformly on [−8, 8], which splits them about evenly between the modes, and from annealed Langevin, which recovers the 0.8 weight. The dashed line is the target.
svg.text: The target, smoothed by noise of size σ
